svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Component · PicPlace pill · syncing
svg.desc: Mirrors PicPlacePill (App/ProjectsView.swift, planned) — the 22×18 media pill a Projects-list card wears on its thumbnail's top-right corner (4pt in) once the project has anything to do with PicPlace: synced (checkmark.icloud.fill, confirm green), syncing (icloud.and.arrow.up, LL.amber — the progress colour over dark), failed (exclamationmark.icloud.fill, system orange). Never drawn for a project that has never been synced, so the list stays quiet for people who never opted in. The media-pill treatment (black at 50%) rather than a second text-row pill: the size line already carries the SourceFormatPill, which on an interval card with FLAT runs to the card's edge, and the thumbnail corner reads the same on every card height.
